# has coordinate observation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasCoordinateObservation`](gmeow-hasCoordinateObservation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCoordinateObservation>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Links a place to a coordinate observation that assigned coordinates or geometry to it. Non-functional: multiple surveys (GPS, LiDAR, total station) may coexist for the same place ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)), and no observation is privileged.
